[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Factions[/color][/head]
When the Kaiser closed the gate, everyone left in Sector Crescent was left to fight over the remains. Four powers hold Taypan today.
This page covers [bold]who they are and what they want[/bold]. For their ranks, their culture, and how they expect to be spoken to, see the [color=#e8b04b]Glossary[/color] pages.
[head=3][color=#684871]Divine Sol Mandate (DSM)[/color][/head]
A neo-feudal remnant of an empire that once stretched across the stars. Sent by the divine Kaiser to secure the starzone after Count Olywir let it fall to the Unionist scourge, the Mandate rules by [bold]rank and blood[/bold], praying to the Saints and to the Kaiser for victory.
Most senior roles are held by noble houses, with House Kircheis at the top. The House of Questions keeps the faithful vigilant, and freeholders and nobles alike who speak against the regime are pressured into silence or are never heard from again. Their carrier, the Aurora Imperialis, ventures into Taypan to kick the League out once again.
[color=#8fc98a]One of the two major powers, and a good start for new players.[/color]
[head=3][color=#bf4d00]New Crescent Worker's League (NCWL)[/color][/head]
A militant syndicalist government born from revolt against House Olywir's quotas, now grown strong enough to rival the Mandate. The League seeks [bold]equality and freedom for every worker[/bold] of the Crescent, whatever their species.
They operate out of their frontline station, Nova Balreska, and are made up of many workers' unions, though those at the front belong to the Homeguard under the iron-willed Volgin Grishingrad. They once liberated the entire sector and deposed House Olywir, but the arrival of House Kircheis reversed most of those gains. Decades of war have left cracks, and dissenters keep quiet rather than answer to the Ministry of Internal Vigilance and Discipline.
[color=#8fc98a]One of the two major powers, and a good start for new players.[/color]
[head=3][color=#535961]Shinohara Heavy Industries (SHI)[/color][/head]
The last corporate giant standing, and a relic of the old world. Cut off from the bubble where they rule a swathe of space as the New American Protectorate, their corporate dogma survives intact, and it is more alien to most of the sector than actual aliens.
As the largest player in archaeotechnology and the holder of much reverse-engineered NanoTrasen work, Shinohara is unrivalled as a technological power. Their fingers are in every pie, from logistics and mining to shipbuilding. They mainly operate from the Prometheus Shipyards, while Tatsumoto sells their wares to all sides, and being wedged between the Mandate, the League, and the Coalition has forced them into a permanent spiral of [bold]Strategic Trade Relations[/bold].
[color=#8fc98a]Trade-heavy and high tech. Expect profit quotas, pirate raids, and little support.[/color]
[head=3][color=#ff7f7f]Taypani Freestations Coalition (TFSC)[/color][/head]
A loose conglomerate of pirates, privateers, shipbreakers, and predatory medical professionals with few qualms about taking your organs. Its most prominent groups are Gorlex Security Consulting, Interdyne Pharmaceuticals, Cyberdawn Technologies, and the Shipfitters Astronautics Workers Union, and together they are often compared to a scavenger ecosystem.
They grew out of the old New Crescent Syndicate of Privateers, formed by Mandate and League defectors who wanted out from under the major powers. Those who saw the hunt coming turned to selling services instead of simple pillaging. Since the destruction of Freeport, the groups have drifted apart and often fight each other. In the Coalition, [bold]strength and results decide everything[/bold].
[color=#8fc98a]Four corporations under one flag. Allies may betray you for a higher paycheck.[/color]
